description: Coded substitution agrees with the existing capture-safe free-variable substitution on the shared formula syntax.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.substitution_correct.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (S : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.EffectiveSignature L) {n : ℕ} (a : L.BoundedFormula ℕ n) (i : ℕ)
  (t : L.Term ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.substitute S n
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.formulaCode S
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.freeName a)
      i
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.termCode S
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.freeName t) =
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.formulaCode S
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.freeName
      (a.subst fun j => if j = i then t else FirstOrder.Language.var j)
